newsitem.title: UK: UK's Oftel again says BT misleads customers.
newsitem.headline: UK's Oftel again says BT misleads customers.

text.p: British telecommunications industry watchdog Oftel on Thursday again rapped BT for misleading customers about competitors, something it first criticised the company for in September.

Oftel head Don Cruickshank said in a statement he had received a new complaint on the subject after he issued an order in September requiring BT to tighten controls over the way in which staff talk about competitors to customers.
Cruickshank said a competitor had raised the complaint.
"I take these allegations very seriously," he said.
He added he would take findings into account in deciding what action to take, "against the background of the existing order."
The order calls on BT to comply with its licence when commenting on competitors' activities.
